# mistershell_canary_service (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell canary_service by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_canary_service" "example" {
  name = "existing-canary-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids.
- `origin_key` (String) Origin key.
- `origin_version` (Number) Origin version.
- `seed_key` (String) Seed key.
- `service_type` (String) Service type.
- `settings` (Dynamic) Settings.
